comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This item is only obtainable from the dungeon inside the Temple of Poseidon which can only be accessed from the Acropolis of Atlantis -- and only if Atlantis is currently in UWO.

As of the Silk Road update, a new group of elemental statue bosses have been added to the dungeon's hidden passages. Each one possesses a unique Aether/Attribute power:

Red = Fire (group damage)
Yellow = Earth (defense/counterattack)
Green = Wind (damage over time/stun-lock)
Blue = Water (healing aura/status ailment cleansing)

As you'd expect, they are extremely difficult to defeat. But if you should prevail, this item will randomly drop from the treasure chest in their boss room; be sure all party members have inventory slots open to receive it.

The Core of a Bronze Statue is necessary to craft and enhance the Apotolos Amina EX weapon; consult its page for further details. Cheers, and... be careful of rushing into those hidden passages...

comments.author: Beomi
comments.body: It is known that you can obtain 0~3 pcs at random after you fight off new attribute bosses of Temple of Poseidon as Guilder commented. was told from some mates of mine that the items which have Increase treasure gained didn't work.
